:::{#exm-binomial-sum-bernoulli}
#### Counting treatment responders

Suppose five patients each respond to a treatment with probability $0.2$,
independently of one another,
and let $X_i = 1$ if patient $i$ responds and $X_i = 0$ otherwise.
By @thm-binomial-sum-bernoulli,
the number of responders $S = \sum_{i=1}^5 X_i$ is $\dBinf{5, 0.2}$,
so the probability that nobody responds is:

$$
\ba
\P(S = 0)
&= \binom{5}{0} (0.2)^0 (1 - 0.2)^{5 - 0}
&& \text{(binomial PMF with } n = 5,\ \prob = 0.2,\ x = 0 \text{)} \\
&= 1 \cd 1 \cd (0.8)^5
&& \text{(} \tbinom{5}{0} = 1 \text{ and } (0.2)^0 = 1 \text{)} \\
&= 0.32768
&& \text{(evaluate the power)}
\ea
$$

:::
